outcomes.description: An existing question remains readable by its owner while a colleague cannot read or confirm it.
A draft is private while it exists, cancellation retains it, and confirmed deletion removes it.
An analyst cannot approve and a current viewer cannot generate a return.
The history ledger opens the exact return and version generated by the story.
An uploaded book passes the real worker, becomes fresh treasury figures and reaches the generated BSD2 return with missing inputs preserved.
A machine key writes its own bank, cannot write a real sibling bank, and loses read and write access after revocation.
A rejected filing is corrected, revised, freshly signed and acknowledged without reusing stale approval.
A sent-back filing preserves withdrawn-signature history and reaches acknowledgement after correction and fresh signatures.
Zero uploaded cash produces zero HQLA and red 0% liquidity coverage.
Uploaded cash corrections pin LCR and its classification at 99.99%, 100.00% and 100.01%.
Level 2A and 2B holdings receive haircuts and both caps before the pinned 50,000 HQLA result.
Savings and loans capital uses its statutory floor while bank projections remain not applicable.
